answer: Each agent stakes capital before its voyage begins, and every epoch's seed must be signed live — a gale of fresh challenges a parked key cannot weather. New identities then enter a nebula of vouching: a key's score rises only if peers burn their own stake to attest. Attacker cost: every sybil child needs its own bond plus vouching collateral, so N clones cost N×stake, and one detected cluster slashes it all at once.
